content.thinking: Got the pricing for SKU-725 from the v2 endpoint after retrying garbled responses, letting me finalize all low-stock item costs (SKU-473, SKU-994, SKU-725) totaling $184.48. I'll store this result now.

content.text:
I stored `184.48` in the note `restock-cost`.

Three products had stock below 5. The other three were at 5 or more, so they need no restock: SKU-916 has 14, SKU-208 has 7, and SKU-547 has exactly 5.

| SKU | Stock | Unit price | Restock cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| SKU-473 | 4 | 4.86 | 29.16 |
| SKU-994 | 1 | 11.38 | 102.42 |
| SKU-725 | 0 | 5.29 | 52.90 |

Many tool responses came back partly garbled, so I re-queried until I had a readable value for each number I used. SKU-725's price is the weakest figure. `get_price` returned garbled output on all three tries, and 5.29 comes from a single `get_price_v2` response that I couldn't cross-check.

FINAL: 184.48
